integrity: Analytical proof includes exact formulas, strict elasticity monotonicity and all positive-rate boundaries. Independent numerical diagnostics complement but do not prove the theorem. Historical priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Idealized renewal resets, independent exponential maturation/senescence, single transiently suitable patch. The objective is long-run suitable-time fraction, not occupancy under imperfect colonization or metapopulation survival. No field calibration, no arbitrary renewal laws or longer stage chains.
title: A single reversal between periodic and Poisson disturbance in a transient successional habitat
